scope: Ketcher isolated upstream function execution + JSmol pinned-source inspection; not a full browser integration test
decision: Use a project-owned shared graph with Three.js + RDKit for this prototype; defer mature-editor adapter integration until ID/stereo/history contracts have dedicated tests.

observations.name: Ketcher actual Pool preserves IDs during local delete/add
Ketcher actual KET serializer omits internal Pool IDs
Ketcher mapping, formal charge, parity and z survive its atom serializer

details.qualification: mapping is the chemical atom-atom mapping field; it is not a permanent editor ID contract

observations.name: Ketcher import explicitly reconstructs atoms and retains mapping
observations.details: Source inspection: importer constructs a new Atom; adapter-owned mapping must be explicit.

observations.name: JSmol ModelKit has real coordinate and topology editing implementations
observations.details: Source inspection confirms atom/bond mutation and actual coordinate rotation/movement; not merely camera orbit.

observations.name: JSmol normal ModelKit editing has automatic hydrogen/geometry side effects
observations.details: Must explicitly configure/adapter-wrap these operations before claiming topology/coordinate preservation.

observations.name: JSmol plain MOL export renumbers records and does not emit external atom IDs
observations.details: MOL atom numbering is export-local; V3000 atom mapping column is written as zero. Jmol SDF has extra atom-name data, but this is not the MOL synchronization path.

observations.name: JSmol stereo export is derived/conditional rather than verbatim metadata
observations.details: V2000 parity comes from 3D coordinates and sorted atom indices; near/far wedge emission is inside is2d. This can be chemically useful but is not a verbatim stereo roundtrip contract.
